title: Character Design Ideas: Real Characters and Prompts
summary: 16 character design ideas from real AI films, each shown as its filmmaker drew it with the exact prompt: monsters, animals, period, modern and 2D.
body_markdown:
### What are some good character design ideas?


Good character design ideas pair a familiar role with one unexpected detail, such as Death as a handsome young man with black wings, a tusk hunter whose eyes have turned white, or an older man in a loud orange floral suit.


### How do I come up with a character design?


Start from the character's job in the story, then add an age, clothes that show who they are and one signature detail, such as a gold nose pin or a fish pendant. If you can describe the character in one line, the design will follow.


### What should a character design prompt include?


A character design prompt should give the age, build, face, hair, clothes with their materials and colours, one signature detail, the style and a plain background. Add what the character must not look like if the model keeps drifting.


### Can AI design a character for me?


Yes. An image model such as GPT Image 2 or Nano Banana Pro can draw a character from a written description, and you can then change one detail at a time by starting each new prompt from the design you like.


### What is the difference between a character design and a character sheet?


A character design is the look of the character, often a single image or a board. A character sheet, or turnaround, shows that same design from the front, side and back on a plain background so it can be drawn or generated the same way in every shot.


### How do I keep my character design consistent in AI video?


Turn the final design into a turnaround sheet with front, side and back views, then attach the sheet to every image and video prompt and name it there, so the model copies the character instead of inventing it again.


### Can I use these character designs in my own work?


The prompts on this page are free to copy as a starting point, but the characters themselves, their names and their images belong to the filmmakers who made them, so change the idea into your own.


### Is it free to design characters in Flick?


Yes, you can start free: a new account gets 100 credits at sign-up and 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and the image models used for the designs on this page run on the Free plan.
